name: luffy
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel art sprite sheet for a side scrolling 32-bit style platformer. Transparent background, NO text or grid lines. Exactly 30 isolated full-body sprites arranged in THREE ROWS and TEN COLUMNS with generous transparent separation. Top row adult, middle teenage, bottom baby with noticeably large head and compact body. All face RIGHT in side/three-quarter gameplay view. Columns: idle, six successive walking stride poses with visibly alternating bent legs and swinging arms, airborne jump knees tucked, extended forward punch, extended forward kick. Within each age row KEEP same head size, helmet diameter, torso proportions and physical scale in every pose; no shrinking during walking. Crisp square pixel clusters, dark plum outlines, limited rich palette, readable at sixty pixels high. No glow, shadows on ground, bubbles or particles outside character silhouette. Round clear glass bubble helmet with pale blue rim and reflections, face visible INSIDE protected air helmet. Fully SEALED opaque diving suit covering torso arms and legs, gloves, closed boots with attached short fins; NO bare arms/legs/midriff/chest. Air tank and collar. Helmet, tank and limbs must be connected to torso, no isolated accessories. Reference image guides character identity and color scheme, but replace exposed skin clothing with full coverage wetsuit. Monkey D. Luffy: black spiky hair, cheerful face, straw hat inside bubble helmet, red upper suit with gold piping, navy full-length lower suit, yellow sash and yellow fins. Three ages match supplied study.
